Service That Made Me Decide Not to Return
Jun 2026 • Couples
I’m a local from Nha Trang, and today I had a very disappointing experience at Samlor. I walked in feeling excited, but left feeling frustrated because of the service.

I arrived around 8:30 PM and ordered three dishes: pork cheek, Pad Thai, and coconut rice. The staff confirmed my order twice. About 15 minutes later, my drinks, the pork cheek, and the Pad Thai were served. I assumed the coconut rice would come later, so I didn’t ask about it. However, the staff member who brought out the food seemed rather unfriendly and unwelcoming.

As for the food, the fish Pad Thai had a noticeably fishy smell, and my friend couldn’t eat it.

At around 9:10 PM, a staff member informed us that the kitchen was about to take its last orders. I wanted to order a dessert and asked for it to be served later since I was still waiting for the coconut rice. After checking with the kitchen, the staff member came back and told us that every dessert on the menu was sold out, which honestly sounded quite unreasonable. Nevertheless, I didn’t argue and continued waiting for the coconut rice.

By 9:30 PM, the kitchen appeared to be cleaning up, yet the coconut rice still hadn’t arrived. I had to call a staff member over to ask about it. What bothered me was that he walked away to check before I had even finished speaking. He later returned and simply told me that he had asked the kitchen to prepare it as quickly as possible.

After waiting far too long, I decided to ask for the bill. What surprised me most was that there wasn’t a single apology for forgetting a dish or making a customer wait nearly an hour. Even after requesting the bill, I had to wait while the staff member continued chatting with a colleague. Only after the table next to us received their bill did I remind him a second time, and only then was my bill printed.

Personally, I won’t be coming back. What disappointed me wasn’t just the food or the forgotten dish, but the way the situation was handled and the lack of genuine care for the customer experience. The service felt robotic and indifferent throughout the entire visit.

I believe the restaurant should seriously reconsider its staff training, especially when it comes to communication and handling service issues. If the goal is to build a loyal local customer base and encourage repeat visits, this is something that needs significant improvement.
